Autocomplete

Autocomplete provides search-as-you-type suggestions from a list of options. It supports custom templates, categories, debounced input, and remote data fetching.

Basic Autocomplete

Start typing to see filtered suggestions from a local list.

HTML
<div class="zak-autocomplete" style="position: relative;">
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Type a fruit..." autocomplete="off">
  <div class="zak-autocomplete-dropdown" style="position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0;"></div>
</div>

Custom Template

Render each suggestion with custom HTML including icons and descriptions.

HTML
<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer;">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm">JD</span>
  <div>
    <div style="font-weight: 500;">John Doe</div>
    <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">john@example.com</div>
  </div>
</div>

Categories

Group suggestions under category headers.

<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer;">Input</div>
<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="padding: 0.5rem 1rem; cursor: pointer;">Select</div>

Clear Button

Include a clear button to reset the input value.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
var fruits = ['Apple','Banana','Cherry','Date','Elderberry','Fig','Grape','Honeydew','Kiwi','Lemon','Mango','Nectarine','Orange','Papaya','Quince','Raspberry','Strawberry','Tangerine','Watermelon'];
var countries = ['Afghanistan','Albania','Algeria','Argentina','Australia','Austria','Belgium','Brazil','Canada','Chile','China','Colombia','Denmark','Egypt','Finland','France','Germany','Greece','India','Indonesia','Ireland','Italy','Japan','Kenya','Mexico','Netherlands','New Zealand','Norway','Peru','Portugal','Russia','South Africa','South Korea','Spain','Sweden','Switzerland','Thailand','Turkey','United Kingdom','United States'];
var users = [
  {name:'Janet Fox', email:'janet@example.com'},
  {name:'Mark Kim', email:'mark@example.com'},
  {name:'Sara Reyes', email:'sara@example.com'},
  {name:'Leo Brooks', email:'leo@example.com'},
  {name:'Ava Mitchell', email:'ava@example.com'},
  {name:'Noah Carter', email:'noah@example.com'},
  {name:'Emma Foster', email:'emma@example.com'},
  {name:'Liam Hughes', email:'liam@example.com'}
];
var categories = {
  'Forms': ['Input','Select','Checkbox','Radio','Switch','Textarea','Range','File Upload'],
  'Data Display': ['Table','Card','Badge','Avatar','Timeline','Stat'],
  'Feedback': ['Alert','Toast','Spinner','Progress','Notification'],
  'Navigation': ['Tabs','Navbar','Breadcrumb','Pagination','Sidebar']
};

function renderSimpleDropdown(dropdown, items, input) {
  var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
  var filtered = items.filter(function (i) { return i.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; });
  dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(function (i) {
    return '<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' + i + '</div>';
  }).join('') : '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results found</div>';
  dropdown.style.display = items.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-autocomplete-item').forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = item.textContent; dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
  });
}

// Basic autocomplete
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('ac-basic-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('ac-basic-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () { renderSimpleDropdown(dropdown, fruits, input); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#ac-basic')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Remote autocomplete
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('ac-remote-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('ac-remote-dropdown');
  var loading = document.getElementById('ac-remote-loading');
  var timer;
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    loading.style.display = 'block';
    timer = setTimeout(function () {
      loading.style.display = 'none';
      renderSimpleDropdown(dropdown, countries, input);
    }, 400);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#ac-remote')) { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; loading.style.display = 'none'; } });
})();

// Custom template autocomplete
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('ac-template-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('ac-template-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
    var filtered = users.filter(function (u) { return u.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 || u.email.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; });
    dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(function (u) {
      var initials = u.name.split(' ').map(function (w) { return w[0]; }).join('');
      return '<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' +
        '<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm">' + initials + '</span><div><div style="font-weight:500;">' + u.name + '</div><div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">' + u.email + '</div></div></div>';
    }).join('') : '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results</div>';
    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-autocomplete-item').forEach(function (item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = item.querySelector('div div').textContent; dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#ac-template')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Categories autocomplete
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('ac-categories-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('ac-categories-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
    var html = '';
    Object.keys(categories).forEach(function (cat) {
      var items = categories[cat].filter(function (i) { return i.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; });
      if (items.length) {
        html += '<div class="zak-autocomplete-category" style="padding:0.375rem 1rem;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--zak-text-muted);margin-top:0.25rem;">' + cat + '</div>';
        items.forEach(function (i) {
          html += '<div class="zak-autocomplete-item" style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' + i + '</div>';
        });
      }
    });
    dropdown.innerHTML = html || '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results</div>';
    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-autocomplete-item').forEach(function (item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = item.textContent; dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#ac-categories')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Clear button autocomplete
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('ac-clear-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('ac-clear-dropdown');
  var clearBtn = document.getElementById('ac-clear-btn');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    clearBtn.style.display = input.value ? 'flex' : 'none';
    renderSimpleDropdown(dropdown, fruits, input);
  });
  clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    input.value = '';
    clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    input.focus();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#ac-clear')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();
